items.prompt: One TCP send contains two application frames. How may the receiver observe the bytes?

options.text: Always exactly two receives, one per frame
options.why: TCP does not preserve application write boundaries.

options.text: Any stream chunking preserving byte order, until failure/closure
options.why: A parser must separate complete frames and retain leftovers.

options.text: As UDP datagrams with automatic duplicate suppression
options.why: That is a different transport and UDP makes no such guarantee.

options.text: Only after the remote business transaction commits
options.why: Transport delivery does not establish business commit.

items.explanation: Stream chunking is independent of application frame boundaries; decode the declared protocol.
